title: shedevro_dk
description: allows you to make 2 clicks per click at the right time
body:
# Shedevro DK

⚡ Shedevro DK is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that adds double click, rapid-click auto mode, a movable on-screen indicator, and a simple in-game settings menu.

## Features

🖱️ Double click for the selected mouse button  
⚡ Auto mode that detects rapid clicking and activates automatically  
⏱️ Adjustable activation CPS  
⌛ Adjustable delay before auto mode turns off after you stop clicking  
📍 Movable status indicator that can be placed anywhere on the screen  
🎮 In-game menu for quick setup  
🧩 Client-side only, no server installation required  

## Controls

🔹 Right Alt — open the mod menu

## Settings

✅ Enable mod  
🖱️ Choose mouse button  
🔁 Set clicks per input  
⚡ Enable or disable auto mode  
📈 Change activation CPS  
⏳ Change turn-off delay  
📍 Show, hide, and move the indicator  
🪟 Allow working inside menus

## Notes

💻 This mod is client-side only  
🚀 Works with Fabric on Minecraft 1.21.11  
📦 Just place the mod `.jar` into your `mods` folder and launch the game with Fabric Loader
